faqs.question: Which countries does this calculator cover?
faqs.answer: USA (federal), UK, Canada (federal), Australia, Germany, Singapore, France, and Japan — all updated for the 2024 tax year.

faqs.question: Is this calculator accurate?
faqs.answer: It provides close estimates based on official tax brackets for each country. It does not include all local deductions, credits, or surcharges — always consult a tax professional for official filings.

faqs.question: Does it include social security and national insurance?
faqs.answer: Yes — UK National Insurance, Canada CPP/EI, Australia Medicare Levy, Germany social security, and US self-employment tax are all shown as separate line items.

faqs.question: What is an effective tax rate?
faqs.answer: Your effective tax rate is total income tax divided by gross income. It is always lower than your marginal rate because lower income slices are taxed at lower rates.

faqs.question: What is a marginal tax rate?
faqs.answer: Your marginal rate is the tax rate that applies to your last dollar of income — i.e. the highest bracket you reach. This is what you pay on any extra income you earn.
